quarterly_data.signal: Jacobs Solutions 10-K: fiscal 2025 revenue was $12,029,783 thousand, of which Infrastructure & Advanced Facilities $10,764,206 thousand (segment operating profit $903,548 thousand) and PA Consulting $1,265,577 thousand; backlog at September 26, 2025 was $23.1 billion, up from $21.8 billion (I&AF $22,649 million, PA Consulting $415 million), with approximately $6.77 billion, or 29.3%, expected to be realized within the next fiscal year and approximately $2.2 billion (9.5%) for the U.S. federal government. Remaining performance obligations were approximately $15.7 billion, 51% expected within twelve months; approximately 32% of fiscal 2025 revenue came from fixed-price contracts and approximately 38% from international operations.
